'''Arkin Bel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3642 BBY]] he was on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where [[Maya Drin]] asked him to rescue the captive [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolans]], but he refused.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Arkin Bel appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the heroic mission "Humanitarian Aid" on Hoth.
